The home screen: one video fills the screen and the next is a swipe away. Desktop is the sidebar plus a centred 9:16 card with its action rail beside it. Phone is full-bleed with a transparent header (the menu on the left) and the four-tab footer. There is no wordmark anywhere, and no avatar in the phone header: Profile is already the last tab, per the workspace_owner. Mute is not a button of its own, per the workspace_owner: a More button, three dots at the top right of the video, opens a sheet on phone and a menu on desktop with Boost, Mute and Report. Only the phone sheet is drawn, below, with the Report reasons. Design change from the code, per the workspace_owner: there is no Post on this screen. A post belongs to a community and the home feed cannot know which one is meant; the app's phone header has a Post that sends you to pick a community, and that goes. Post lives on the community page. States below: signed out, signed in, loading, empty, error. Design change from the code, not yet approved: the empty and error wording is my proposal. The code shows "No videos yet" with "Published community videos will appear here." and "Video feed unavailable" with "Try again in a moment." Source: features/posts/video-feed and the shell.

More: three dots at the top right of the video. The sheet has Boost, Mute and Report. Report opens one sheet of reasons, and a tap sends it. Phone only.
Boost is the app's existing way to add rewards to a song: a share of the daily Megapot lottery, or a cash bonus in an admitted token (coming soon). Feed items already carry a boostEligibility of eligible or unavailable, so the row shows only on eligible videos, and it is hidden while a lottery is already running on the song. The reward goes on the song, not on this video, so the form names the song. The form is on Screens/Boost.
Mute is the video's sound, nothing else, and reads Unmute while muted.
Report sends the video to the community's moderator, privately, with one of the seven reasons the spec allows: spam, harassment, hate, sexual content, graphic content, misleading, other. A report alone never hides anything. The API only lets members of the community report, so the row is hidden for signed-out viewers and for people who are not members; this is an edge case and the workspace_owner left it to me. Letting anyone report needs an API change.
Source: Spec 010 (reports); Solid features/rewards (Boost, reward sponsor); rewards brief Surface B; api-next community moderation contracts.
